name: Demo 1: Clean Bumper Repair
narrative: I was slowly reversing into a parking slot at the mall in Bandra, Mumbai and bumped into a low pillar. Front bumper cover and lower grille got dented.
expected_reason: Active policy, covered bumper repair, low fraud risk (12/100), net payout under ₹2,000 threshold (₹850.00 net), no other driver fault.

name: Demo 2: Street Racing Exclusion
narrative: I was participating in an impromptu street racing drag pull on Outer Ring Road, Delhi when my vehicle hit a road barrier. Damaged bumper and intercooler.
expected_reason: Section 3.B excludes street racing and speed stunts. Pauses for adjuster review (never auto-denied without human confirmation).

name: Demo 3: Suspicious Repair Estimate
narrative: I brushed against a roadside pole on MG Road, Bengaluru which broke the passenger side mirror.
expected_reason: Policy bought 4 days before crash; narrative describes minor mirror scratch but garage billed ₹6,800 for roof replacement and chassis alignment. Fraud score > 70.

name: Demo 4: Other Driver at Fault
narrative: I was stopped at a red light on Western Express Highway, Mumbai. A Blue Dart Express commercial freight truck failed to brake in time and rear-ended my car. Traffic police issued challan #MH-88192 to truck driver for negligent driving.
expected_reason: Clear other-party liability against commercial freight truck. Pauses for claims officer to prepare recovery notice against the truck's insurance.
